en.content: The number of water molecule(s) directly bonded to the centre in CuSO . 5HO is __________.
en.explanation:
The structure is CuSO . 5HO [Cu(HO)]SO . HO

so, HO molecules directly attached to Cu are 4.

en.content: The coordination number of Al in the crystalline state of AlCl is ___________.
en.explanation: AlCl3 exists as a close packed lattice of chloride ions Cl– with Al3+ occupying octahedral holes. Hence, coordination number of Al3+ is = 6.
